title: Base class for warnings about deprecated features.
summary: A subclass of Warning, Exception, BaseException.

title: Check that imported or used feature is deprecated.
summary: If you use --enable-error-code deprecated, mypy generates an error if your code imports a deprecated feature explicitly with a from mod import depr statement or uses a deprecated feature imported otherwise or defined locally. Features are considered deprecated when decorated with warnings.deprecated, as specified in PEP 702. mypy does not enable this error code by default. Use --enable-error-code deprecated to enable it.
